services.name: snorkeling trip
services.desc: While Key Largo, Islamorada, Marathon, Key West, and all of the Florida Keys are well known for beautiful shallow coral reefs and spectacular fish and wildlife, snorkeling in Islamorada is known as some of the best in the Keys. Our reefs range in depths from 4 feet to 20 feet, which makes snorkeling enjoyable for everyone in your family. All of the coral reefs we visit are simple to navigate and are a spectacular sight. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced snorkeler you will definitely enjoy the scenery of the Florida Keys water. services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: For adventure seekers looking to combine many Florida Keys tour activities into one boat tour, KeyZ Charters in Islamorada offers a variety of custom combination tours to experience all of the wildlife and nature of the region. You can create a custom tour to fulfill almost anything your heart desires. Each trip is customized to your desires, specific locations, catering picnics, birthdays, anniversaries, and more. If you can think of it, we can most likely accomplish it. Give us a call with your ideas, and our experienced staff will guide you to provide the most perfect trip for your wants. services.name: eco tours
services.desc: Explore the Florida Keys with a private boat charter and enjoy a unique eco-tour of Islamorada, Florida. Convenient to both Key Largo and Marathon, you'll be able to cruise through the mangrove channels and search for wildlife like the American saltwater crocodile, herons, ospreys, egrets, iguanas, manatees, and dolphins. If you're lucky, you may even spot the American bald eagle in flight. On our private eco-tours of the Florida Keys, you will be able to observe the unique wildlife and plants of the area. blurb: KeyZ Charters operates from Islamorada, providing private boat tours that explore coral reefs, sandbars, mangroves, and wildlife habitats in the Florida Keys. They offer customizable experiences including snorkeling, eco-tours, sunset cruises, historic island visits, and sandbar excursions. Their captains are USCG-licensed and knowledgeable about local waters, focusing on safety, comfort, and environmental care.
